pin_formula: rho = 2R tan(pi/4 + lat/2); x = rho sin(lon); y = rho cos(lon); col = (x - x_min)/(x_max - x_min)*width; row = (y_max - y)/(y_max - y_min)*height
orientation: pole at the image centre; 0 E meridian points up (+y), 90 E to the right
source: LOLA PGDA LDEM_60S_240MPP_ADJ_HILL.TIF hillshade (sun 45 deg alt / 45 deg az), Barker et al. 2023
